messages:
elaine: Observed a p99 tail at 02:14 caused by tiny-allocation fanout. Pattern: many <2KB requests pin staging pages -> eviction lags -> head-of-line stalls.

elaine: Quick triage: the host-staging policy pins to avoid pagefaults, but under burst it saturates.

nik: Quick mitigations: (1) reduce pinned-window from 300ms -> 50ms as emergency, (2) route tiny allocs to ephemeral mmap fastpath that never pins across requests.

sam: Ephemeral reduces global stalls but increases pf churn and harms cold p99. Alternative: tiny_slab + per-tenant soft credits + global reclaim bucket; fallback to ephemeral when credits exhausted.

sam: Prototype config: tiny_slab.max_pages=768, per_tenant_credits=6, reclaim_burst=32, ephemeral_fallback=true. Credits age out over 10s.

elaine: Obs asks: tiny_slab.usage, tiny_slab.evictions, ephemeral.pagefault_rate, per_tenant.soft_credit_used. Add sampled traces on first N stalls/min.

ci-bot: CI flaky on branch pin-mitigation: tests/test_small_infers.py::test_concurrent_latency failed (expected <=50ms got 210ms).

sam: I'll repro locally and run perf matrix (pf-rate, p50/p99, eviction).

elaine: Plan: ship tiny_slab+credits behind 5% canary and add console knob for pinned-window emergency kill. If good, follow up with RFC for allocator contract (credit API + reclaim hooks).

elaine: Action items: sam: spike + numbers; nik: console knob + alerts; elaine: dashboards and sample traces.

sam: ACK, will post results here.
